Hi Marie,

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday — the team at Lumina had great questions about our streaming response latencies and the embedding throughput for your indexing jobs. I know your procurement team has the PO queued but there’s a timing mismatch with your evaluation window that could put the sandbox offline mid-workshop next week.

To avoid losing momentum, we can provision a short-term \"stitch\" credit to keep the pilot environment live while the PO clears. Proposed plan: 72-hour token grant (approx. 150k tokens) applied to your sandbox account; automatic rollback if the PO is not received after the window. No invoice changes required — this is purely to preserve the evaluation.

Attached: pilot-summary-lumina.docx (demo checklist + token estimate).

If that sounds acceptable, please reply with a quick confirmation and loop procurement (I’ve included their address for convenience) and I’ll escalate for an internal approval.

Best,
David
